tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: The app and public page background, and the ground for text and the transcript.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: The sidebar and side panels, set off from the app by a hairline seam.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the composer, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills, such as an inactive area or a muted row.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: The active nav row, the segmented control thumb and the initials avatar.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, titles and Claude's replies, on every ground in the contrast table.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, meta lines, margin receipts and helper text.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the quietest labels, only at 13 px and up.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Seams between the sidebar, panels and content, and dividers.

tokens.name: line-card
tokens.usage: Card and dialog borders.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Outlines of chips, outlined pills and the whisper composer. Flagged: 2.0:1 on the app background, under the 3:1 for control borders, which is acceptable only because the control's own text identifies it.

tokens.name: line-control-hover
tokens.usage: The same outlines on hover.

tokens.name: fill-card
tokens.usage: Card fill over the app background.

tokens.name: fill-count
tokens.usage: Count pills and the segmented control track.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons and nav rows.

tokens.name: fill-bubble
tokens.usage: The visitor's message bubble.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: fill-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: button-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: an inverted neutral, never a color.

tokens.name: button-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: button-primary-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring and selection. Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: ring-composer
tokens.usage: The composer's focus ring, solid at 2 px so it reaches 3:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: status-handled
tokens.usage: Handled or allowed: a 6 px dot or thin bar beside words that say the same thing.

tokens.name: status-held
tokens.usage: Held, or needs you: a 6 px dot or thin bar beside words that say the same thing.

tokens.name: status-refused
tokens.usage: Refused or blocked: a 6 px dot or thin bar beside words that say the same thing.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational: a hollow 6 px dot beside words that say the same thing.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The Claude Desk mark, and nowhere else.

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: The greeting at the top of Today.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Claude Desk wordmark beside the mark.

styles.name: summary
styles.usage: Claude's summaries, such as what an approval asks for.

styles.name: reply
styles.usage: Everything Claude says in a transcript.

styles.name: message
styles.usage: What people write: the visitor's bubble, the owner's messages and the composer.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Margin receipts, card labels and the concept footer.

styles.name: beta
styles.usage: The Beta label under the wordmark.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: The business's name in the public page header.

styles.name: trace
styles.usage: Values inside an expanded full trace, and nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The tightest nudge, such as an icon's optical offset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between a label and its hint, and inside count pills.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a status dot and its words.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related controls, and a bubble's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Side padding of compact controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, and side padding of controls.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: A bubble's side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding and the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Roomy card padding, and between messages.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections, and above the page title.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Between turns in a transcript.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between regions of a page.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Content side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav rows and the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, switches and avatars.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the owner sidebar.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content.

tokens.name: size-reading
tokens.usage: Width of the conversation reading column.

tokens.name: size-margin
tokens.usage: Width of the take-over bar's controls column, beside its lines.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of standard controls.

tokens.name: size-control-main
tokens.usage: Height of a screen's main action.

tokens.name: size-nav-row
tokens.usage: Height of a sidebar nav row.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Line icons.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: The initials avatar.

tokens.name: size-brand-header
tokens.usage: Height of the public page's brand header.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The composer only. Everything else is set apart by fill and a hairline.

motion.note: Kept in the repo only: the published design system has no motion family, so these ship in its stylesheet.

tokens.name: motion-instant
tokens.usage: Color changes on hover and press.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback and small state changes.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: A check that draws once, or a reveal.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: The delay between results that arrive one by one.

tokens.name: motion-ease
tokens.usage: The default easing.

tokens.name: motion-ease-emphasis
tokens.usage: Easing for the one small moment on a screen.

tokens.name: motion-breathe
tokens.usage: The slow loop of presence glyphs; static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-writing
tokens.usage: The loop of the writing indicator; static under reduced motion.
